title: 1.5 Laboratory Safety
description: General laboratory safety rules and procedures

questions.question: What should be worn in the laboratory to protect your clothing from chemicals and spills?
questions.correctAnswer: Lab coat or apron

questions.question: What should be worn to protect your eyes from chemicals, glass shards, or other hazards?
questions.correctAnswer: Safety goggles

questions.question: Why should eating and drinking be prohibited in the laboratory?
options: Food and drink can become contaminated with hazardous chemicals
questions.correctAnswer: Food and drink can become contaminated with hazardous chemicals

questions.question: How should chemical wastes be disposed of in the laboratory?
options: Poured down the sink with water
Thrown in the regular trash bin
Follow proper waste disposal guidelines provided by the teacher
Left in the containers open to evaporate
questions.correctAnswer: Follow proper waste disposal guidelines provided by the teacher

questions.question: What should you do if a chemical spills on your skin?
options: Wipe it off with a paper towel
Rinse the affected area with plenty of water immediately
Wait for the teacher to arrive
questions.correctAnswer: Rinse the affected area with plenty of water immediately

questions.question: What is the correct way to smell a chemical in the laboratory?
options: Place the container under your nose
Smell it only if it is labeled safe
Waft the fumes toward your nose with your hand
questions.correctAnswer: Waft the fumes toward your nose with your hand

questions.question: What should you do if a fire starts in the laboratory?
options: Notify the teacher and use a fire extinguisher if trained
questions.correctAnswer: Notify the teacher and use a fire extinguisher if trained

questions.question: Where should flammable materials be kept in relation to a Bunsen burner flame?
options: Close to the flame for easy access
questions.correctAnswer: Away from the flame

questions.question: What is the first step to take if someone gets injured in the laboratory?
options: Notify the teacher and seek medical attention
questions.correctAnswer: Notify the teacher and seek medical attention

questions.question: What is the purpose of a first aid kit in the laboratory?
options: To treat minor injuries such as cuts and burns
questions.correctAnswer: To treat minor injuries such as cuts and burns

questions.question: Why should long hair be tied back in the laboratory?
options: To prevent it from catching fire or getting caught in equipment
questions.correctAnswer: To prevent it from catching fire or getting caught in equipment

questions.question: Why should loose clothing be avoided in the laboratory?
options: It can catch fire or get caught in equipment
questions.correctAnswer: It can catch fire or get caught in equipment

questions.question: What should you do before leaving the laboratory at the end of a session?
questions.correctAnswer: Wash your hands thoroughly

questions.question: How should broken glass be disposed of in the laboratory?
options: Thrown in the regular trash bin
Left on the floor for later cleanup
Placed in a designated sharps or broken glass container
questions.correctAnswer: Placed in a designated sharps or broken glass container

questions.question: What should you do if you are unsure about a laboratory procedure?
options: Watch a classmate and copy them
Ask the teacher for instructions before starting
Skip that part of the experiment
questions.correctAnswer: Ask the teacher for instructions before starting

questions.question: Where should backpacks and personal belongings be kept in the laboratory?
options: On the floor near your feet
In designated storage areas away from the work area
questions.correctAnswer: In designated storage areas away from the work area

questions.question: What should you do if you cut yourself with a scalpel or broken glass?
options: Wash the wound and apply a bandage from the first aid kit
Blow on it to clean it
questions.correctAnswer: Wash the wound and apply a bandage from the first aid kit

questions.question: Why is it important to keep the laboratory bench clean and organized?
options: To make cleaning easier at the end
questions.correctAnswer: To prevent accidents and contamination

questions.question: What should you do if you accidentally break a thermometer containing mercury?
options: Clean it up with a paper towel
Notify the teacher immediately as mercury is toxic
questions.correctAnswer: Notify the teacher immediately as mercury is toxic

questions.question: How should chemicals be transported in the laboratory?
options: Carry them with both hands and walk carefully
questions.correctAnswer: Carry them with both hands and walk carefully

questions.question: What is the correct way to heat a test tube?
options: Point the open end away from yourself and others
Point the open end toward yourself
questions.correctAnswer: Point the open end away from yourself and others

questions.question: Why should you never use chipped or cracked glassware?
options: It does not hold liquids well
It may break during use and cause injury
questions.correctAnswer: It may break during use and cause injury

questions.question: What should you do if an electrical cord is frayed or damaged?
options: Notify the teacher and do not use the equipment
questions.correctAnswer: Notify the teacher and do not use the equipment

questions.question: Why is it important to know the location of the fire extinguisher, eyewash station, and first aid kit?
options: To respond quickly in case of an emergency
To use them for regular experiments
questions.correctAnswer: To respond quickly in case of an emergency

questions.question: What should you do if a chemical splashes into your eyes?
options: Flush your eyes at the eyewash station for at least 15 minutes
questions.correctAnswer: Flush your eyes at the eyewash station for at least 15 minutes

questions.question: Why should you not use laboratory glassware for eating or drinking?
options: It may be contaminated with chemical residues
questions.correctAnswer: It may be contaminated with chemical residues

questions.question: What is the correct way to dilute a concentrated acid?
options: Add acid to water slowly while stirring
Heat the acid before adding water
Mix them in equal amounts quickly
questions.correctAnswer: Add acid to water slowly while stirring

questions.question: Why should you never return unused chemicals to their original containers?
options: It could contaminate the entire supply
questions.correctAnswer: It could contaminate the entire supply

questions.question: What should you do with used matches and lit materials after using a Bunsen burner?
options: Place them in a designated heat-resistant container
Throw them in the trash bin
questions.correctAnswer: Place them in a designated heat-resistant container

questions.question: What is the purpose of a fire blanket in the laboratory?
options: To smother small fires or wrap around a person whose clothing is on fire
questions.correctAnswer: To smother small fires or wrap around a person whose clothing is on fire
